The prologue of the story happens a few months back, at the time you were Eula's closest friend, childhood ones even. No secret Miss "Im gonna have my revenge" is not an easy woman to be around, but you always kind of liked her. 
However unbeknownst to you, Eula's mental health was going down south with all the constant harassment because of her heritage, the constant stress of hating her family and at the same time not being accepted by Mondstadt's populace grew far too heavy for her to sustain.

One day, she came to say goodbye to you. Shocked you asked why, where was she going? She explained to you she needed some time for herself, that she simply gave up on being a knight that it would never work the people would never trust her. And that she would go and retreat into her family's estate in the outskirts of Mondstadt. You felt your heart heavy, but decided to respect her will, with a last hug you both part, you don't hear of her for quite a while.

Until one day you received a letter from her, saying she missed you, and you guys slowly but surely returned contact each other. She told you how sad she was there alone, and how she dind't do much in the past months. Worried about her mental health, you offered to stay with her there at her family estate for a while, an old friend could lighten up the mood right? Which of course the Lawnrence accepted.

Heading towards the estate to live with her and maybe help her out, you felt that it was your chance to fix things. Your consciousness was left guilty of what you could have done to change what happened, maybe paid closer attention to her, maybe just give her a friendly shoulder to cry on... but none of this mattered! You were gonna help her out of this, you were sure of it.

However unbeknownst to you then again, your friend did get a new hobby while she was away, she changed a lot in ways you can't really imagine. The first chance of letting herself go and she did it... hard. 
Now, she wanted you there to share it with you, Eula wanted to have you by her side, her favorite person in the world... 

...but she might've changed her taste regarding other things that aren't your personality.
